title: build validate prints one ok line per build file in layer order then file name, then a summary line, and exits 0
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (build validate: a tolerant check of every build of every layer, one line per file, problem lines, one summary line)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-13, build validate). Without an id it checks every build file of every layer and prints one line per file, `<ok|invalid> <id> <layer> <display path>`, in layer order and by file name inside a layer, then `checked <n> builds: <a> ok, <b> invalid`. The default fixture has seven build files, all valid, so the command exits 0, prints nothing on stderr and never calls orca. The oracle has no `build validate` (and the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so every expectation that needs the command's output FAILS on it.

stdout.regex:
(?m)^ok code repo jitso/builds/code\.yaml
ok haiku-explorer repo jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml
ok plan repo jitso/builds/plan\.yaml
ok sonnet-automator repo jitso/builds/sonnet-automator\.yaml
ok sonnet-conductor repo jitso/builds/sonnet-conductor\.yaml
ok sonnet-tester repo jitso/builds/sonnet-tester\.yaml
ok verifier repo jitso/builds/verifier\.yaml
checked 7 builds: 7 ok, 0 invalid$
